scenario_text:
It's a price comparison page. The same twenty or so listings get requested
thousands of times an hour — everyone lands on the same handful — and the
prices behind them only get refreshed from suppliers three or four times a
day. Between refreshes the answer to every request is identical. Around 300 
people on the site at once, roughly 5 GB of listing and price data. The box
is 6 GB RAM, 4 vCPU. Nothing regulated.
